title: Abelian stalk germs on strictly henselian open subschemes
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme, $U\subset T$ an open subscheme with inclusion $\iota$ [def-weil-open-immersion], $R$ a strictly henselian commutative local ring [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], and $e:U\cong\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to T$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], with factorization $t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to U$ satisfying $t\circ\iota=s$ and $e\circ t$ lying over the closed point of $\operatorname{Spec}R$. For every abelian etale sheaf $F$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], its germ map from $F(U)$ to $F_s$ at the pointed neighbourhood $(U,t)$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 03QO (lemma-vanishing-etale-cohomology-strictly-henselian), its set-valued stalk identification applied inside the open subscheme U

proof.text: Compose F with the forgetful functor from abelian groups to sets. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-sets-strictly-henselian-open-sections-stalk] to this sheaf and the given pointed open neighbourhood. This gives a bijection for the set-valued germ, hence an isomorphism in Type.

The forgetful functor preserves filtered colimits (Mathlib.Algebra.Category.Grp.FilteredColimits). Shrink this preservation instance to the universe of the pointed neighbourhood category. Point.presheafFiberCompIso compares the set-valued stalk with the underlying set of the abelian stalk. Point.toPresheafFiber_presheafFiberCompIso_hom_app identifies the composite of the set-valued germ with this comparison with the forgetful image of the abelian germ.

Both factors of this composite are isomorphisms. The forgetful functor reflects isomorphisms, so the abelian germ is an isomorphism. This works for any coefficient universe at least the one required for these colimits.
